evals.prompt: Подними наш форк SS13 на чистой Ubuntu через TGS в Docker — проведи с нуля.
evals.expected_output: Walks the ten-step checklist in order, opening references only as each step is reached; checks RAM and disk against the hardware section BEFORE the first deploy and prescribes swap/zram on a small box; reads the BYOND version from the repo's dependencies.sh rather than .tgs.yml; sets the instance to Host Write; seeds Configuration/GameStaticFiles/config/ instead of editing Game/Live/config; and PROPOSES each command rather than executing it against the user's host on its own initiative.

evals.prompt: На новом сервере tgui-окна пустые, а nginx сыплет 404 на голый корень. С чего начинать?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the two-symptom fingerprint (log_write runtimes plus a flood of 404s on the bare CDN root) as a non-loading librust_g.so rather than an nginx problem, and checks it with ldd inside the container before touching the web server; on a glibc mismatch offers the build-from-source path with PKG_CONFIG_ALLOW_CROSS=1 and --ignore-rust-version; separately keeps the missing-CORS failure mode (assets download and are discarded, endless retry loop) as the OTHER candidate, distinguished by whether assets actually exist in webroot_assets/.

evals.prompt: Каждый раз после деплоя мои правки в config.txt пропадают. Что не так?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the edits as having been made in Game/Live/config, which TGS recreates on every deploy, and moves them to Configuration/GameStaticFiles/config/, which is linked into each new deployment; explains the container-path versus host-path duality (config.txt takes container paths, nginx takes host paths) so the fix does not introduce a second bug.
